sentences.text: Shri Sonal Gupta - Govt. Advocate for respondent/State.
Learned counsel for the appellant does not want to press I.A. No.19768/2024.
Accordingly, I.A. No.19768/2024 is dismissed as not pressed.

I.A.No. 3933/2024, repeat (3rd) application under Section 389(1) of Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 filed on behalf of the appellant - Sangram for grant of bail and suspension of remaining jail sentence.
The appellant has been convicted vide judgment dated 23.01.2019 passed by the learned IVth Additional Sessions Judge, Dewas (MP) in in S.T. No.05/2017 for the offences punishable under Sections 348, 376(2) and 370-A of IPC and sentenced to undergo 2 years, Life imprisonment and 5 years RI with fine of Rs.1000/-, Rs.1000/- and Rs.2000/- respectively with default stipulation.
Learned counsel for appellant submits that the present appellant has completed more than 5 years of jail incarceration.
This appeal is of the year 2022 and there is no likelihood of its early hearing.
Hence, it is prayed that the application be allowed and appellant be released on bail.
Learned counsel for the respondent / State opposes the application and prays for its rejection.
It is not in dispute that after the alleged incident, the appellant/applicant married to the prosecutrix and staying together as husband and wife.
Two children were also born from the said wedlock.

In view of the aforesaid reason, without commenting upon the merits of the case, this Court is of the considered opinion that the application for suspension of custodial sentence filed on behalf of the appellant deserves to be allowed.

Accordingly, I.A.No. 3933/2024 is allowed and it is directed that subject to deposit of fine amount, if already not deposited, with the trial Court and on furnishing personal bond by the appellant in the sum of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only ) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court, the execution of Sagram vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86655742/

The appellant after being enlarged on bail shall mark his presence before the Registry of this Court on 04.04.2025 and on such other dates, as may be fixed in this behalf.
List for final hearing in due course.
I.A. Nos.15362/2024 and 16418/2024 are disposed of.
C.C. as per rules.

(SURESH KUMAR KAIT) 
 CHIEF JUSTICE   Biswal
